intended_object: The identity morphism of quivers (identity prefunctor) V ⥤q V. It sends every vertex to itself and every arrow to itself. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition sends each vertex X to X and each arrow f to f. This is exactly the identity morphism of quivers. It is stated for an arbitrary quiver on any type, which is the natural generality. This is Mathlib's own basic definition of the notion, so there is no other Mathlib counterpart to cite.
